config_files.notes: Valheim stores its graphics, audio, display resolution, and accessibility settings in the Windows registry under HKCU\Software\IronGate\Valheim. Keys use Unity hash suffixes. Edit via regedit or PowerShell only while Valheim is fully closed.
Low-level Unity renderer configuration. Controls job systems, threading modes, and API selection. Edited by adding key=value lines.

keys.effect: Native photosensitivity accessibility feature: dampens thunderstorm lightning flashes, portal strobes, and high-luminance combat flashes.
keys.notes: Added in modern Valheim updates. Highly recommended for any user with photosensitivity concerns or seeking reduced visual glare.
Disabling bloom prevents intense light flares from torches, fires, portals, and sunlight, improving visual clarity and photosensitivity safety.

keys.effect: Sun shafts (god rays) streaming through foliage and fog.
keys.notes: Can create rapid strobe flickering when travelling through dense forests. Disabling aids photosensitivity and motion comfort.

keys.effect: Dynamic camera roll/tilt aligned with ship motion on ocean waves.
keys.notes: Disabling locks the horizon to a stable plane while sailing, eliminating the primary nausea and vestibular motion sickness trigger in Valheim.

keys.effect: Horizontal render resolution in pixels (e.g. 5120 for 32:9, 3440 for 21:9, 2560 for 16:9).

keys.notes: FSR 2 upscaling is built into modern Valheim, providing clean edge anti-aliasing and a 20-30% framerate uplift on high-resolution displays.

keys.effect: In-game frame rate cap in FPS.
keys.notes: Setting slightly below monitor refresh rate (e.g. 237 on 240Hz) ensures optimal G-Sync / VRR engagement without tear or frame buffering latency.

boot_config_keys.effect: Enables Unity's multi-threaded rendering job system. Significantly improves CPU utilisation on quad-core and above hardware.
boot_config_keys.notes: Validated across Unity versions. Highly impactful for Valheim's CPU draw call bottlenecks in large bases and dense biomes.

boot_config_keys.effect: Enables native graphics job rendering alongside gfx-enable-gfx-jobs.
Forces Unity 6 Jobified multithreaded rendering backend.
boot_config_keys.notes: Default in modern Unity 6 builds of Valheim. Ensures optimal worker thread scheduling across all CPU cores.

manual_only_settings.recommendation: Use BetterUI Reforged or MinimalUI mod via r2modman or Thunderstore to center HUD elements to a 21:9 or 16:9 bounding box.
manual_only_settings.reason: Valheim renders ultrawide (21:9 and 32:9) natively without FOV crop, but Unity UI anchors to extreme outer edges. Centering HUD prevents neck strain on super-ultrawide monitors.

manual_only_settings.recommendation: Shadow Quality: High, Vegetation: High. Ashlands and Mistlands biomes are significantly heavier than Meadows.
manual_only_settings.reason: Granular mesh and light cascades are adjusted via in-game settings.

notes: Valheim is out of Early Access (1.0 release), having migrated to Unity 6 (6000.x).
Modern builds include native FSR 2 temporal upscaling and dedicated accessibility options (ReduceFlashingLights).
The boot.config multithreaded rendering tweaks remain fully compatible and recommended for modern multi-core systems.
Ultrawide 32:9 and 21:9 are supported out-of-the-box for world rendering; HUD relocation requires UI mods.
